traces.name: ext_orphans_continuous_100
traces.note: KI-65: lazy lenders through forced deep rebases, converting in random orders; 0-token burns leave dust residues below the next rebase's unit; whole exits while lumps vest

traces.name: ext_orphans_dust_100
traces.note: KI-65: dust amounts (1..40 raw tokens): most holdings are below one new share at a rebase, so the records' rounding units decide who holds S; whole exits while lumps vest
